traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The frog can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.text: The frog’s long jump is up to 10 feet and its high jump is up to 5 feet, with or without a running start. A frog has no effective attacks. It feeds on small insects and typically dwells near water, in trees, or underground. The frog’s statistics can also be used to represent a toad.
